content.text: Locate the requested UI element in the current image.

CURRENT image: 1440x900. Locate the button labeled AC. Call click once with its center of the button in normalized coordinates, x=0..1000, y=0..1000. The origin is the top-left of THIS input image; each axis spans the full image. Use only the CURRENT image, not previous positions. Set found=true when located. If absent or uncertain, set found=false and ALL coordinates=0.

function.name: click
function.description: Report one target location; no action is executed.
